In 2025 it got only **23% to 67%** of it (DE_LU 39.3% vs 72.0%), and in Spain in 2026 to 2 Oct (as-of date; snapshot `analysis/outputs/snapshots/2026-10-02/`) overnight charging costs **34.9% more** than plugging in at 18:00.
